rounds.ai_message: Good morning. This is Tom from Sunshine Finishing. What fabric do you want to finish?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好，我是旭日后整理的 Tom。您要做什么面料的后整理？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍，说明面料品种和用途
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want to do finishing'; say 'We need finishing for our fabric'.
rounds.tips_zh: 联系后整理厂先报面料成分、克重和最终用途。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Tom. This is Anna from Ningbo Best Garments. We need finishing for our 100% cotton twill, 240 GSM, for a jacket line.

rounds.ai_message: OK, cotton twill 240 GSM. We can do heat setting on the stenter and pre-shrinking. Do you need sanforizing?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的，全棉斜纹 240 克重。我们可以做拉幅定型和预缩。需要做预缩整理吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认需要预缩，问预缩率
rounds.common_mistakes: sanforize 是动词也是名词，不要说 'make it no shrink'。
rounds.tips_zh: 全棉梭织预缩后残余缩水率通常控制在 3% 以内。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, we need sanforizing. We need the residual shrinkage under 3%.

rounds.ai_message: Sure, we can control shrinkage under 3% on the sanforizing line. What about the surface — do you need peaching or sueding?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没问题，预缩线上我们可以把缩水率控制在 3% 以内。表面方面——需要磨毛吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明表面手感要求
key_phrases: We want a soft peach skin
rounds.common_mistakes: peaching 和 sueding 都是磨毛；peaching 更轻、suading 更重，别混用。
rounds.tips_zh: 磨毛程度要写明：light / medium / heavy，避免大货与样不符。
rounds.user_response_example: We want a soft peach skin touch, light peaching only. The handfeel should be soft, not furry.

rounds.ai_message: Got it, light peaching for a soft handfeel. What finished width do you need after stenter?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白，轻磨毛做软手感。拉幅后成品门幅要多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认成品门幅
rounds.common_mistakes: 门幅要说 finished width 或 cuttable width，不要说 fabric width only。
rounds.tips_zh: 拉幅定型决定最终门幅；58/60 英寸是常见成品门幅。
rounds.user_response_example: Finished width should be 58/60 inches after stentering. Cuttable width is very important for our markers.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Any special functional finish, like water repellent or softener?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。需要特殊功能整理吗，比如防水或柔软剂？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明需要防水整理
rounds.common_mistakes: water repellent 防泼水，waterproof 完全防水，两者差别很大。
rounds.tips_zh: 外套常用防泼水 DWR；完全防水需涂层或贴膜。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, we need a water repellent finish, C6 DWR, for outerwear. It should pass 10 wash cycles.

rounds.ai_message: Fine. For heat setting, sanforizing, light peaching and C6 DWR, the price is US$0.85 per meter. MOQ is 3,000 meters.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。拉幅定型加预缩加轻磨毛加 C6 防泼水，价格每米 0.85 美元，起订量 3,000 米。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格与起订量，尝试议价
rounds.common_mistakes: 后整理按米或公斤计价，不要问 price per piece。
rounds.tips_zh: 后整理加工费随整理项目叠加；功能整理加价 0.1-0.2 美元/米。
rounds.user_response_example: The price is a bit high. Could you do US$0.80 per meter? We will have repeat orders next season.

rounds.ai_message: I can do US$0.82 for you. Lead time is 10 days after we receive your grey fabric and the lab sample is approved. Is that OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我可以给您 0.82 美元。收到您的坯布、小样批核后 10 天交期，可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认交期，约定先打样
key_phrases: please make a trial sample first
rounds.common_mistakes: lead time 起点要写清：after sample approval，不是 from today。
rounds.tips_zh: 后整理大货前必须打 trial sample 确认手感、门幅、缩水率。
rounds.user_response_example: 10 days is fine. Please make a trial sample first for handfeel and shrinkage approval before bulk.

rounds.ai_message: No problem. Please send 20 meters of greige fabric for the trial. I will send the quotation sheet by email today.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没问题。请寄 20 米坯布做试样。我今天把报价单邮件发您。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认寄样和收报价，收尾
key_phrases: we will send the greige tomorrow
rounds.common_mistakes: greige fabric 坯布，不要说 grey cloth 的字面翻译 'gray fabric' 混淆灰色面料。
rounds.tips_zh: 试样坯布 15-20 米，注明成分克重，快递单号同步给对方。
rounds.user_response_example: OK, we will send 20 meters of greige fabric tomorrow. Please send the quotation to anna@bestgarments.com. Looking forward to the trial sample.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Anna, Tom from Sunshine Finishing. I saw your inquiry for polyester pongee finishing. Before quoting, what's the end-use and what functional finishes do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Anna，我是旭日后整理的 Tom。看到你涤纶春亚纺后整理的询价。报价前想问下最终用途和需要哪些功能整理？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明用途与功能整理组合
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要只说 'for jacket'；功能整理要一次说全，否则报价不准。
rounds.tips_zh: 羽绒服面料需防绒 down-proof、防泼水 DWR，常配套轧光 calendering。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Tom. It's 20D polyester pongee for lightweight down jackets. We need down-proof finish and C6 water repellent, plus a light calendering for a clean face.

rounds.ai_message: Clear. For 20D pongee, heat setting on the stenter is critical for width stability. What finished width and GSM tolerance do you require?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 清楚。20D 春亚纺，拉幅热定型对门幅稳定很关键。成品门幅和克重公差要求多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给出门幅与克重公差
rounds.common_mistakes: tolerance 后接具体数值，不要只说 small tolerance。
rounds.tips_zh: 轻薄面料定型温度 160-170°C，过高会黄变、发硬。
rounds.user_response_example: Finished width 57/58 inches, width variation within 1 cm, and GSM tolerance within ±3% after heat setting.

rounds.ai_message: Noted. Since it's for down jackets, do you also need PU coating on the back, or is cire finish enough for down-proof?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 记下。既然是羽绒服面料，背面需要 PU 涂层吗，还是轧光就能防绒？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在涂层与轧光之间做选择并说明理由
rounds.common_mistakes: cire 是轧光上光工艺，不要写成 shiny finish。
rounds.tips_zh: 轻薄羽绒优先轧光防绒保透气；PU 涂层防风强但增重、透气差。
rounds.user_response_example: We prefer cire finish for this style — PU coating adds weight and hurts breathability. If cire fails the down-proof test, we'll consider a light acrylic coating instead.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. One more option to flag — some buyers laminate a TPU membrane for better water resistance. Do you want lamination as an alternative?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。再提醒一个选项——有些客户复合 TPU 膜来提高防水。要不要把复合作为备选方案？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估复合方案的成本与性能
key_phrases: lamination is too heavy for this style
rounds.common_mistakes: lamination 复合，coating 涂层，工艺和成本不同，别混说。
rounds.tips_zh: 复合面料看耐水压 hydrostatic head（mmH₂O）和透湿 MVP 指标。
rounds.user_response_example: Lamination would be too heavy for a 20D lightweight style. But please quote it as option B — with hydrostatic head above 3,000 mm, in case our customer upgrades the spec.

rounds.ai_message: Fine, two options then. About handfeel — our standard silicone softener may affect the water repellent performance. Do you want softener in the same bath or a separate pass?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好，那就两个方案。手感方面——我们的常规硅油柔软剂可能影响防水效果。柔软剂要同浴做还是单独过一遍？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 了解工艺冲突，做出安排
rounds.common_mistakes: same bath 同浴、separate pass 分步，是后整理常用表达。
rounds.tips_zh: 硅油柔软剂与 DWR 同浴会降低拒水等级，分步加工更稳。
rounds.user_response_example: Let's do a separate pass to protect the DWR rating. Handfeel must stay soft though — please trial both routes and send us samples for comparison.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. Pricing: option A with cire and C6 DWR is US$0.92 per meter; option B with TPU lamination is US$1.85. MOQ 3,000 meters each. Lead time 12 days after trial approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 会安排。报价：方案 A 轧光加 C6 防泼水每米 0.92 美元；方案 B TPU 复合每米 1.85 美元。起订量各 3,000 米，试样批核后 12 天交期。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 就方案 A 议价并确认交期
key_phrases: 12 days works if trial passes this week
rounds.common_mistakes: 议价要报总量作筹码，不要只说 too expensive。
rounds.tips_zh: 复合工艺价格约为涂层的两倍；用量报整季总量更有议价空间。
rounds.user_response_example: Option A at US$0.88 per meter would close it — our total volume is 15,000 meters this season. And 12 days works if the trial passes this week.

rounds.ai_message: Deal at US$0.88 for 15,000 meters. One concern — your last lot had 4.2% shrinkage after washing, above the 3% spec. Should we add a compaction pass this time?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 成交，15,000 米 0.88 美元。有个顾虑——您上批货水洗后缩水 4.2%，超过 3% 的规格。这次要加一道压实预缩吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应历史缩水问题，确认改进方案
rounds.common_mistakes: 承认问题并给方案，不要说 'last time was not our problem' 推卸。
rounds.tips_zh: compaction 机械压实是针织和部分梭织的补缩手段；要求附 AATCC 135 缩水测试报告。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, please add a compaction pass and target residual shrinkage under 3%. Attach the AATCC 135 wash test report with the shipment this time.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. I'll send the confirmation sheet today with both options, prices, tolerances and the compaction note. Please courier 30 meters of greige for the trials.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。我今天发确认单，含两个方案、价格、公差和压实预缩备注。请快递 30 米坯布做试样。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认寄样、给快递信息与收件邮箱，收尾
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾要给明确的试样时限，不要只说 'please hurry'。
rounds.tips_zh: 试样周期 3-5 天是行规；确认单写清双方案单价便于客户升级。
rounds.user_response_example: We will courier 30 meters tomorrow and share the tracking number. Please complete the trials within 5 days and send the confirmation sheet to anna@bestgarments.com.

rounds.ai_message: Anna, Tom here. Before we talk specs — your PO lists 'peached, sanforized, water repellent' for the cotton twill, but your approved counter sample was sueded, not peached. Which one governs? That changes our line setup and price.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Anna，我是 Tom。谈规格之前先说清楚——您 PO 上写的是磨毛、预缩、防水，但批核的对样是绒面磨毛，不是桃皮绒。以哪个为准？这影响我们的产线安排和价格。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 澄清标准以谁为准，控制责任边界
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要含糊说 'both are OK'；手感差异会直接导致索赔。
rounds.tips_zh: peaching 砂磨桃皮绒、sueding 金刚砂磨绒，外观手感不同；规格与封样冲突时以书面修正为准。
rounds.user_response_example: The counter sample governs — medium sueding, not peaching. My merchandiser will revise the PO today so the written spec and the sealed sample match.

rounds.ai_message: Good, sueding it is. Now, on the water repellent — your tech pack asks for 80 spray rating after 20 washes, but you specified a C6 finish. C6 at this price point won't hold 80 after 20 washes. Do you want to upgrade to a C0 PFC-free, or relax the wash requirement?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好，就做绒面磨毛。再说防水——您工艺单要求 20 次水洗后喷淋 80 分，但指定 C6 整理。这个价位的 C6 撑不到 20 洗 80 分。要升级 C0 无氟，还是放宽水洗次数？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在升级配方与放宽指标之间做决策
rounds.common_mistakes: C6/C0 指氟碳链长度，不是浓度；C0 即 PFC-free 无氟。
rounds.tips_zh: 欧美品牌逐步禁用 PFC；C0 无氟拒水剂单价高 15-25%，但符合 ZDHC 趋势。
rounds.user_response_example: Our buyer's RSL requires PFC-free, so we upgrade to C0. Tell me the surcharge per meter and reconfirm it still hits 80 spray after 20 washes — that's non-negotiable.

rounds.ai_message: C0 adds US$0.15 per meter, and yes, we guarantee 80 spray rating after 20 washes — we'll run AATCC 22 and 135 in-house and send the reports. But I need your commitment on one thing: no silicone softener in the final pass, or the rating drops. Your handfeel will be firmer. Accept that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: C0 每米加 0.15 美元，20 洗 80 分我们担保——厂内做 AATCC 22 和 135 测试并附报告。但您要接受一点：最后一道不能加硅油柔软剂，否则分数掉下来。手感会偏硬，接受吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 权衡手感与防水指标，提出折中
key_phrases: trial both and let our buyer judge
rounds.common_mistakes: trade-off 是地道表达；不要说 'I want both perfect'，那不现实。
rounds.tips_zh: 拒水兼容型柔软剂（DWR-compatible softener）是行业折中方案，成本略高。
rounds.user_response_example: Not a full accept — run one trial with a DWR-compatible softener and one without. We'll have our buyer judge the handfeel against the spray rating and decide in 48 hours.

rounds.ai_message: Fair. Next, shrinkage. Your spec says 3% max, but last season we ran your twill at 2.8% and your QC still rejected a lot claiming 'twist after washing'. Spirality isn't covered by your shrinkage spec — do you want to add a spirality tolerance?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以。下一个，缩水。您规格写 3% 上限，但上季我们做到 2.8%，您 QC 仍以'水洗后扭斜'为由拒了一柜。扭斜不在您缩水规格里——要加扭斜公差吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 承认规格漏洞，补充扭斜指标
rounds.common_mistakes: spirality 扭斜是针织/斜纹常见问题；口头拒收没有依据，必须写进规格。
rounds.tips_zh: AATCC 179 测扭斜度；规格补全后双方都有验收依据，避免扯皮。
rounds.user_response_example: Point taken — that rejection lacked a written basis. We'll add spirality within 3% per AATCC 179 to the spec, and in return we need your commitment that no lot ships above it.

rounds.ai_message: Deal. Now the uncomfortable part — we found 600 meters in your incoming greige with oil stains and reed marks. We can process around them, but yield drops about 8%. Who absorbs that loss — your mill or you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 成交。现在说不愉快的部分——您发来的坯布里发现 600 米有油渍和筘痕。我们可以避开加工，但得率会掉约 8%。这个损失算织厂的还是您的？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 界定坯布瑕疵责任，协商损耗分担
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要情绪化指责；先要看坯布进厂检验记录界定责任。
rounds.tips_zh: 坯布进后整理厂应做 incoming inspection 并双方签认，是划分瑕疵责任的关键证据。
rounds.user_response_example: We signed off on your incoming inspection report, so the claim goes to our weaving mill, not you. For this lot, we split the 8% yield loss — you absorb the processing cost, we absorb the fabric value.

rounds.ai_message: That's reasonable, thanks. Then let's talk coating for your second fabric — the nylon taslan for rainwear. Your spec says PU coating with hydrostatic head 5,000 mm, but your target price only buys PVC-level quality. PVC is cheaper but fails your buyer's REACH list. Which way do we go?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 这样处理很公道，谢谢。再谈您第二款面料的涂层——雨衣用尼龙塔丝隆。规格写 PU 涂层耐水压 5,000 mm，但您的目标价只够 PVC 档次的品质。PVC 便宜但过不了贵司买家的 REACH 清单。怎么选？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 坚守环保合规，重谈价格或调整指标
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要为省钱暗示接受不合规材料；REACH/RSL 是红线。
rounds.tips_zh: PU 涂层分溶剂型和水性；水性 PU 环保但牢度需验证；PVC 含邻苯风险，多数品牌禁用。
rounds.user_response_example: REACH compliance is mandatory — PVC is off the table. Re-quote with water-based PU and we'll negotiate from there. If the price gap is too big, we can lower the hydrostatic head to 3,000 mm for this season.

rounds.ai_message: Water-based PU, hydrostatic head 3,000 mm — re-quoted at US$1.45 per meter, 10% above your target. And before you push back: cotton futures and silicone prices are both up, so this is cost-driven, not margin-driven. Can you close at US$1.40 with a 20,000-meter commitment?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 水性 PU、耐水压 3,000 mm——重新报价每米 1.45 美元，比您目标价高 10%。先说清楚：棉价和硅油都在涨，这是成本驱动不是利润驱动。20,000 米的量 1.40 美元能定吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 以量换价并锁定有效期
key_phrases: review clause if raw material drops
rounds.common_mistakes: 锁定大单要同时锁有效期和价格回调条款，单边锁价风险高。
rounds.tips_zh: 大宗议价用 'commitment + validity + review clause' 三件套，既压价又防涨价。
rounds.user_response_example: We can close at US$1.38 with the full 20,000 meters, provided the price holds 30 days and we add a review clause — if silicone and cotton drop more than 5%, we re-open pricing. Fair on both sides.

rounds.ai_message: US$1.38, 20,000 meters, 30-day validity with the review clause — agreed. I'll issue the finishing confirmation with sueding, C0 water repellent, AATCC 22/135/179 test commitments, the yield-loss split, and water-based PU coating terms. Counter-sign by Friday so we can book the stenter line.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 1.38 美元、20,000 米、30 天有效期加回调条款——同意。我今天发后整理确认单，含绒面磨毛、C0 防水、AATCC 22/135/179 测试承诺、损耗分担和水性 PU 涂层条款。请周五前回签，我们好排定型机台。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认回签与排产节点，专业收尾
key_phrases: book the stenter line after approval
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾要约定排产触发条件和进度汇报频率，不要签完就失联。
rounds.tips_zh: 大货后整理要约定周报节点；定型机台排产紧张，回签延迟会影响交期。
rounds.user_response_example: We'll counter-sign by Friday. Please book the stenter line upon signature and send us weekly production updates with test reports as each lot completes. Good working with you, Tom.
